content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments allows digital creators to bypass the restrictions of conventional payment processors. By utilizing decentralized payment methods, creators gain the ability to transact freely, regardless of geographical limitations. This matters because it opens up new revenue streams, enabling creators to monetize their digital products without being subjected to the high fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. With NOWPayments, creators only incur a 0.5% fee, which can lead to substantial savings—particularly when selling high-ticket items.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of selling design assets through crypto payments is built on a stack of reliable tools that ensure seamless transactions and delivery. Utilizing platforms like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Supabase for order management creates an automated workflow. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain, triggering an automatic delivery of the digital asset. This infrastructure not only guarantees instant product delivery but also maintains data ownership, allowing creators to fully control their business operations without interference from third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing payment processing restrictions. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or design assets, this infrastructure caters to your needs without the limitations of conventional payment gateways. By focusing on creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and similar regions, the architecture empowers you to operate independently, retain more profits, and scale your business without the fear of sudden policy changes or account limitations that come with traditional payment platforms.
Retain 100% of your earnings with low crypto payment fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your online store, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that automates sales and product delivery. This eliminates the need for manual intervention, allowing creators to focus on what they do best—creating valuable digital products. By leveraging these technologies, you ensure that your operations remain efficient and cost-effective.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital commerce stack, start by selecting the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Next, set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and configure your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions and ensure your products are loaded for sale. Finally, test the entire workflow to confirm that payments and deliveries are functioning correctly. For a comprehensive resource, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline this process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a crypto payment solution like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, directly from your customers. By implementing a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can automate delivery and maintain full ownership of your sales process, maximizing your profits with lower fees compared to traditional platforms.
Own your entire digital commerce infrastructure without dependency on platforms.

For creators looking to expand their digital sales capabilities, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) can provide all the necessary blueprints and templates. This resource will help you set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows you to accept crypto payments without relying on conventional platforms. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
